descriptionHtml:
90 × 70cm to 130 × 90cm. Metal frame. Nothing in it to go soggy.

Bassenthwaite is a raised mesh dog bed on a metal frame, in Large 90 × 70cm, XL 110 × 80cm and XXL 130 × 90cm. There is no foam in it and no cover to wash.

Somewhere in your house there is a bed that went in the bin after one wet winter. It took on water from every muddy walk, held the smell through every wash, and never came back right.

This one has no filling. The deck sits up on a metal frame with air moving under it, so mud dries and brushes off.

What they get

  • A deck lifted clear of the floor: Air moves underneath, so heat is not trapped between a thick coat and a cold tile.
  • A metal frame under taut breathable mesh: The mesh spreads their weight rather than collapsing under it.
  • No foam and no loose filling: Nothing to go soggy after a wet walk and nothing to get pulled out.
  • Thirty seconds with a hose: Rinse it down and let it dry. No cover to wrestle off, no wash cycle.
  • Three deck sizes up to 130 × 90cm: Usable corner to corner, because no bolster takes a slice out of it.

Best for: Heavy-coated breeds, muddy dogs, hot sleepers and households with hard floors.

Why it is worth the money

£89 for the Large, £109 for the XL and £119 for the XXL. That buys a frame and a deck, which is all this bed is. A £30 supermarket bed costs less on the day and comes with a stuffed pad that soaks, packs down and smells. Nothing here does any of that.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One thing to know first. Mesh is firm with no give in it, so a thin-coated dog will want a blanket over the deck in January. That is the trade-off for a bed you can hose.

Size and fit

SizeDeck (cm)Suits
Large90 × 70Cocker spaniel, Staffordshire Bull Terrier
XL110 × 80Labrador, collie, working springer
XXL130 × 90German shepherd, lurcher, greyhound

The whole deck is usable sleeping area, so there is no bolster to lose space to. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Rinse the mesh and frame with water and let it dry fully. Keep it on a level surface and check the frame joints occasionally.

Shade and water still matter in hot weather. A raised bed does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Can I actually leave it outside? Yes. Indoors or out: conservatory, utility room, garden, kennel or campsite.

How is this different from Windermere? Different job. Windermere is built around summer heat and opens at £79. Take this one for mud, wet coats and a 130 × 90cm XXL deck.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
